correctness.rationale: Exact integration of the held input gives M(h). Symbolic multiplication verifies the period-two trace and determinant and the identities \(1-\operatorname{tr}(P)+\det(P)=k_p(a+b)(a+b-k_dab)\) and \(2(1+\operatorname{tr}(P)+\det(P))=\Phi\). Within the fixed-period stability interval, the determinant condition and first Jury inequality are strict, leaving \(\Phi>0\) as the necessary-and-sufficient remaining condition. The exact witness has \(\\(\(\(\Phi=-253/1250\)\)\)\), \(p(-2)=2903/2500\), and \(p(-1)=-253/2500\), so its two-step map has a real multiplier in \((-2,-1)\).

value.rationale: Sampling jitter is a practical issue in networked feedback. The result precisely separates fixed-period stability from period-two stability and gives an exact necessary-and-sufficient design test, with a rational counterexample demonstrating that checking each interval separately can be misleading. The criterion applies to all positive gains and all interval pairs inside the individual stability range, rather than one numerical instance.
